name: M15 compression-break continuation and reversal screening batch

research.category: intraday compression and completed-close breakout screening

source_references.citation: Holmberg, Lönnbark and Lundström (2013), Assessing the profitability of intraday opening range breakout strategies, Finance Research Letters 10
source_references.supports: Indirect evidence that some intraday breakouts can trend; its opening-range crude-oil event does not support a preceding FX compression rule.

source_references.citation: Magner, Sanhueza and Lavín (2026), When is a breakout informative? Market conditions and technical signals, Finance Research Letters
source_references.supports: Contrary long-horizon evidence: equity breakouts load on momentum and lack significant factor-adjusted alpha; transfer to intraday FX is unsupported.

source_references.citation: Girgin (2026), The Calm Before More Calm? Daily Bollinger and TTM Squeezes, Volatility Clustering and the Leverage Effect in S&P 500 Stocks, SSRN
source_references.supports: Adverse working-paper evidence: daily squeezes do not precede volatility bursts and the tested squeeze-breakout rule loses; it is not peer reviewed.

research.evidence_summary: No direct cost-aware intraday study supports the rule. Evidence is indirect or adverse, so this is an explicitly speculative falsification batch inside the existing I-32/I-33 family.

feasibility.rationale: The design uses only supported FX M1 OHLC, causal M15 state, signal-close fills, fixed ATR stops and same-day exits, but shared batch primitives still await V2 preflight confirmation.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 12:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed completed M15 closes through the signal bar; elapsed market gaps do not reset ATR, but the complete prior compression block and signal bar must be physically contiguous M15 intervals
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute); a London M15 bar ending 09:00 contains [08:45,09:00)

Require exactly 15 consecutive unique M1 candles; valid OHLC means finite positive open/high/low/close, high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), and high>=low; a duplicate is invalid before aggregation

Compute TR=max(high-low,abs(high-prior_observed_close),abs(low-prior_observed_close)), including elapsed daily/weekend gaps; initialize Wilder ATR(96) as the arithmetic mean of the first 96 valid observed TRs, then update ATR_t=(95*ATR_{t-1}+TR_t)/96; freeze ATR through t-1 before evaluating close_t
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: Compression describes volatility state but supplies no established directional prediction
The closest registered squeeze study is adverse and nearby V2 breakout families have failed or decayed
Six correlated symbols and 72 correlated cells are not independent trials
No development result authorizes final-holdout access

hypothesis.behavior: After a low-range M15 block, a completed close outside the frozen block may continue as volatility expands or reverse as a failed breakout.
hypothesis.mechanism: Continuation could reflect delayed order execution after a range constraint; reversal could reflect stop-triggered liquidity demand that exhausts at the completed break.
works_when: The block is genuinely compressed relative to prior-only ATR
One response sign persists across exact neighboring settings and survives all costs
fails_when: Compression has no incremental directional information
The completed close enters after the move is exhausted
Spread, slippage and false breaks absorb gross returns
falsifiable_predictions: A declared response-mode center and at least two exact one-axis neighbors have positive net R
The cluster is positive in both UTC-midpoint development halves and at least three symbols
The cluster survives doubled costs and removal of the center's five best London dates

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: TR_i=max(high_i-low_i,abs(high_i-previous_observed_close),abs(low_i-previous_observed_close)), including elapsed gaps; seed with arithmetic mean of first 96 valid observed TRs, then ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96 through t-1
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal bar t; 98 valid observed closes through t provide prior close, 96 prior TRs, and close_t

definitions.name: block_high_low
definitions.timing: Uses only L completed bars before t

definitions.name: compression_ratio
definitions.formula: median(sorted true_range_{t-L:t-1}) / atr96_prior; for even L the median is the arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted TRs
definitions.timing: Require finite atr96_prior>0 and compare before direction mapping

definitions.name: break_direction
definitions.formula: +1 if close_t>high_L; -1 if close_t<low_L; otherwise no signal
definitions.timing: Known only at the completed M15 close; wick-only breaks do not count

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: break_direction for CONTINUATION and -break_direction for REVERSAL

entries.long_condition: eligible completed M15 t AND compression_ratio<=compression_ratio_max AND ((close_t>high_L AND response_mode=CONTINUATION) OR (close_t<low_L AND response_mode=REVERSAL)) AND finite atr96_prior>0 AND no open position for this symbol and cell
entries.short_condition: eligible completed M15 t AND compression_ratio<=compression_ratio_max AND ((close_t<low_L AND response_mode=CONTINUATION) OR (close_t>high_L AND response_mode=REVERSAL)) AND finite atr96_prior>0 AND no open position for this symbol and cell
entries.signal_time: Close of a London-aligned M15 interval ending 09:00 through 12:45 on a weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes is no later than 15:00
entries.execution_details: entry_price is the chart/bid close of M1 [signal_time-1 minute,signal_time), also the completed M15 close. Stop distance uses that chart price; V2 separately applies resolved or fixed-fallback spread, commission and slippage. The entry candle cannot trigger the new stop; management begins with the next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
No pyramiding or reset from an overlapping event
Wick-only block breaks do not qualify
Bars t-L through t must be physically adjacent 15-minute intervals; any gap inside that event window means no signal

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop = signal_close_bid-stop_atr_multiplier*atr96_prior; short bid-chart stop = signal_close_bid+stop_atr_multiplier*atr96_prior. Long triggers on bid, short on executable ask; adverse gap fills at V2's worse executable open with all costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at the M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; any invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails the affected cell before exit; a valid due bar touching the stop resolves STOP_LOSS first
exits.maximum_holding: At most 120 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No eligible entry may mature after 15:00 London; no pre-entry bars means no signal, while an in-position data defect fails only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each grid cell owns an isolated virtual portfolio. Within one cell, size same-timestamp symbol signals from that cell's common pre-entry equity snapshot so chart entry-to-stop risk equals 0.25% before costs; no equity, exposure, position or skip state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell: maximum six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; there is no global cap shared across the 72 isolated cell portfolios
risk.leverage: Use the lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip if valid size cannot be represented
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell, one per symbol and six across its universe; all 72 cells have independent positions, equity, exposure, overlap decisions and data-failure state

robustness_tests: Report all 72 cells and every prior compression/opening-breakout trial that can be identified
Report every symbol and halves split at the exact UTC midpoint of V2's fixed development interval; a close exactly at midpoint belongs to the first half
Multiply spread, commission and slippage individually by two for cost stress

For each mode center L=8/c=0.75/hold=60/stop=1, rank dates by normal-cost pooled net R, tie by ascending date, remove its top five from the center and exact neighbors, and require retained normal- and doubled-cost net R to remain positive

For every center and neighbor, form a London-weekday daily net-R series from its first eligible post-warm-up date to development end, including zero on eligible no-trade dates; report a 95% percentile interval for mean daily net R from 10000 circular five-date block-bootstrap resamples with seed 2026008; the normal-cost center interval lower bound must exceed zero, while neighbor intervals are report-only
A mode advances only if its center and at least two exact one-axis neighbors L=4, L=16, c=0.50, hold=30, hold=120 pass all gates
costs: Use V2 timestamp-resolved or frozen fixed-fallback spread plus commission and slippage at every fill
Doubled stress multiplies each cost component by two
No swap because all positions close before 15:00 London
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical compression breaks

Exactly two non-selectable plain-break diagnostic rows: CONTINUATION and REVERSAL at L=8, hold=60, stop=1, with no compression condition; each uses its own isolated position state and otherwise identical signal clock, fills, costs and failure rules; report trade count, mean daily net R, and compressed-center minus plain mean daily net R
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 72 selectable cells, the two frozen non-selectable plain-break diagnostic rows, and all identifiable prior I-32/I-33 and opening-breakout trials. The plain rows cannot alter advancement or become promoted settings. If the historical ledger is incomplete, label multiplicity incomplete and prohibit a confirmatory claim; no best-cell rescue is allowed.
rejection_criteria: Reject a mode unless its center and at least two exact neighbors are positive after normal and doubled costs
Reject if the cluster is non-positive in either UTC-midpoint development half
Reject if fewer than three symbols have positive center net R in each half
Reject if the center has fewer than 300 pooled trades
Reject if five-date removal makes the center or required neighbors non-positive under either normal or doubled costs
Reject if the normal-cost center's seeded circular-block-bootstrap 95% interval for mean London-weekday daily net R does not lie wholly above zero
Reject affected cells on any invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] and prohibit promotion if a required cluster contains a failed cell
Never access the final holdout without explicit authorization for a separately frozen promoted version

pseudocode: Build valid London-aligned M15 bars causally from interval-start M1.
Maintain prior-only Wilder ATR(96) and freeze L-bar high, low and median true range for each L.
At eligible M15 close t require compression and a close strictly outside the frozen block.
Map continuation or reversal mechanically and enter at signal close when that cell is flat.
Freeze the bid-chart ATR stop; starting next M1 process adverse gap/intrabar stop before due time exit.
Fail only affected cells on an invalid interval through and including the due exit.
Run exactly two separate non-selectable plain-break center diagnostics and publish their incremental mean-daily-net-R comparisons, all 72 cells, exact neighbors and robustness rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: duplicate M1 is invalid before aggregation
valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low
elapsed market gaps count in observed-sequence ATR but any gap within t-L through t suppresses the signal
close exactly at block boundary is no signal
stop and time exit collide as stop first
gap stop uses worse executable open
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol; cache shared M15, ATR and block features while preserving independent position state for 72 cells.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue submission waits for V2's response to the shared R007 M15/fill/cell-state preflight and a batch-specific result-shape compatibility review
